question: Should named LiteLLM onboarding grow an interactive proxy URL and model setup path, or should remote LiteLLM users be directed to Custom Provider or broader dynamic catalog work?
rationale: The source-backed bug remains, but the right repair is a provider UX/API direction choice rather than a mechanical one-line fix.

options.title: Add LiteLLM interactive setup
options.body: LiteLLM would prompt for proxy base URL and API key before model selection while preserving the existing non-interactive flag behavior.

options.title: Route to Custom Provider
options.body: Keep named LiteLLM onboarding API-key-only and update docs or wizard copy so remote proxy users use the existing Custom Provider flow.

options.title: Defer to dynamic catalog work
options.body: Leave this issue open until maintainers define a broader live provider catalog policy that includes LiteLLM model discovery.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM interactive setup
recommendation.body: LiteLLM would prompt for proxy base URL and API key before model selection while preserving the existing non-interactive flag behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently owned the LiteLLM onboarding pluginization and the narrower carried-forward fix for this area.
